title: Gối mây
about: Round 33, ke-chuyen-gan ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác album mới, theo phong cách ambient và dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Những giấc mơ nhỏ: a cloud for a pillow, B-flat major in 3/4 at 58 bpm, the piano as a felt piano (darker, struck softer). Its motif floats on long notes down the chord and up again; the middle in G minor reaches C6; the violas' thin line under it. Written to sleep to, on the sound the user settled on (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes (each middle section 16 bars, a sentence and its variation), the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, the climax stays low. An original tune.
